blocks.text: Zscaler uses integrations to provide visibility and security for SaaS applications used in your organization. You can authorize SaaS applications with Zscaler by adding them as tenants. In ZDX, you can configure a data collection integration to a tenant for data collection, or webhooks.
Data Collection provides the following benefits and enables you to:

blocks.item: Configure integrations (e.g., Microsoft Intune) for data collection to access Endpoint Analytics.
Configure webhooks to create alert notifications.

blocks.text: On the Data Collection page (Digital Experience > Settings & Configurations > Data Collection), you can do the following:

blocks.item: Search for a data collection integration.
Add a new integration for Microsoft Intune data collection.
Select which column fields to display.
View the following for each data collection integration:
Name: The name of the data collection integration.
Onboarded On: The date the integration was configured.
Status: The status of the integration.
Actions: Manage your data collection integration.
